board: MCXN947 Cortex-M33 core 0, single core FreeRTOS V11.1.0
method: The real high-priority task delays for one tick. A CAS hook pends real SysTick while the low-priority task owns busy. Periodic tick requests are stopped during this deterministic test; real IRQ masking and PendSV task switching are exercised. Test-only symbol-renamed implementation; no production scheduling hook.

freertos-demoMPSC hardware begin
MPSC PASS rounds=128 checks=2571 high=128 irq=128
baseline_rtt:
freertos-demoMPSC hardware begin
MPSC HIGH entered while busy
restored_demo_rtt:
freertos-demo[    0.000000] [ SYS] nanosig debug bridge -> SEGGER RTT
[    0.000000] [ SYS] led: en=1 color=0 freq=0 (boot)
restored_firmware: normal-demo.elf (fly normal FreeRTOS demo with the preemption fix)
limits: This verifies forced single-core task-preemption interleavings and nested/full-queue handling, not all RTOS or SMP configurations.
No worst-case interrupt-latency benchmark, long-duration stability test or physical button interaction test.
